explication: react-native-ble-plx is a React Native BLE client library. An app uses the exported BleManager API to observe adapter state, scan for peripherals, connect, discover GATT services, and perform characteristic or descriptor operations; results and events return through the JavaScript/native bridge. Platform code performs BLE operations, while JavaScript model objects expose devices and GATT resources. The README also documents RSSI, MTU negotiation, iOS background support, and an Expo config plugin. Native implementation details beyond the sampled Android and bridge files are represented only at the subsystem level.
